email.body1:
Nick, saw ChurnZero launched Agentic Essentials this month.

A new product line usually spikes follow-up volume past what an SDR team can keep up with, so in-market accounts go untouched and response speed slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations, not research: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for ChurnZero.

For an SDR team working a new launch, the lift usually hides in follow-up consistency and how fast a signal becomes a personalized touch. Multi-channel alone drives 287 percent more responses than single channel.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for ChurnZero.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ChurnZero's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up volume off your reps without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Around a launch, timing is everything, and I know ramping the team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team? I will tailor it to ChurnZero either way.
